depot_player_view.prompt: Photoreal AAA open-world game environment concept, eye level from a player standing on a tyre-rutted dirt track. The Outer Berms of the desert planet Tir: a ruined machine depot at the far end of a dusty no-man's-land. A collapsed industrial processing hall: skeletal rusted steel portal frames with knee braces, half the corrugated roof sheets gone and one bay folded down to the ground, torn sheets hanging. A long rusted conveyor spine on steel trestles runs out of the hall and has broken, one section slumped onto the sand. In the middle, three shattered drone charging cradles (squat steel pylons with clamp arms and cracked housings) still faintly glow restrained cyan: the power source a feral robot cluster guards. Cracked oil-stained concrete apron half buried under drifted ochre sand, scorch marks, cable runs snaking over the ground, heaps of stripped machine scrap and dead robot parts, broken concrete retaining walls with rebar. Two lean orange-and-cream feral bipedal worker droids patrol, one yellow hover drone with two ducted rotors hangs above. Warm late-afternoon hazy dust-bowl light, long shadows, sandstone escarpment behind. Believable scale, grounded, weathered, no text, no people.
